claim: At the production tpr64 launch geometry, reconstruction costs NOTHING on Qwen3.8. Codec choice is not constrained by reconstruction time.

evidence.activation: REAL captured BF16 post-norm hidden, token 192 of a 256-token holdout - explicitly not synthetic
evidence.codecs_at_tpr64_ns: 15,124-15,541 for q4/q3/q2/binary/ternary/additive_q2q2/hadamard/rice - i.e. the SAME as uncompressed f32
evidence.same_codecs_at_tg256_ns: ~26,500 - the penalty is LAUNCH GEOMETRY, not the codec

what_this_retires: The 5.9x rice reconstruction penalty. It was an artifact twice over: first measured against Q80's serial 1-thread-per-row extract, then TRANSFERRED to Qwen3.8 without re-measurement. Both steps were wrong and the second was flagged as unresolved by the lane that did it.
corroboration: Q80's reconstruction fix reached the same conclusion from the opposite direction - in-register consumption took gpu_matvec from 867.0 to 36.6 ms without changing a single codec.
consequence_for_G006: The descent under 1.5 BPW can select on QUALITY ALONE. Take the lowest BPW that preserves coherence; it will not cost time at tpr64. This removes the tradeoff the first descent screen was built around.
how_this_survived: The lane DIED without writing grok-report.md or an exit code. tools/lane_health.py detected it processless and idle, preserved the worktree to 709820607, and the measurement survived. Without that tool this result would have been reaped.
